subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers that reject prompt messages in `input`, should OpenClaw add a documented opt-in prompt-placement compatibility mode or keep the current request shape and route affected users to provider-specific workarounds?
rationale: The failure affects provider compatibility, but the likely fix adds or changes public provider config behavior and can affect providers with opposite role expectations.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
options.body: Keep current defaults and support a documented compatibility switch that moves the system prompt to top-level `instructions` for strict relays.

options.title: Fix only role propagation
options.body: Require a focused current-main repro for why `reasoning: true` becomes `system` and repair that path without adding prompt-placement config.

options.title: Decline strict-relay support
options.body: Keep core behavior unchanged and direct affected operators to `openai-completions` or provider-specific workarounds.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in instructions placement
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and support a documented compatibility switch that moves the system prompt to top-level `instructions` for strict relays.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent owner signal for the current AI provider package and adjacent OpenAI provider docs/runtime work.
